cp10k, contradictions, broken_promises, bps and words count the scenes write would have drafted: up to the first refusal, or through the first gate failure, inclusive (before this measure they counted every scene; those figures are now *_all). scenes, length_drift and voi cover every drafted scene. The *_all figures count every drafted scene (the scenes after the first failure are drafted from a ledger missing its facts). cp10k_passed is the rate in the scenes the gate passed, anywhere in the act (what write would commit). gate_caught / gate_missed / gate_false_alarm are per scene against the judge's contradictions, over every drafted scene.
The gate's checker and the judge are both Opus continuity reviews, so part of a CP10k drop may be the two agreeing; the human spot-check is still owed.
